# Nisc Cloud

> Kenya's A-to-Z digital partner. We create your brand from scratch, deploy it online, market it to generate real customers and sales, then automate everything with Zeepo AI — all under one roof, one team, one invoice.

Nisc Cloud provides end-to-end digital services for Kenyan businesses and businesses across Africa. Our four-step Atom Approach covers the full business digital lifecycle: Create, Host, Market, and Automate with Zeepo AI.

## Atom Approach

1. **Create** — Brand identity, logo design, website design and development, e-commerce stores, creative assets, and brand copywriting.
2. **Host** — Enterprise cloud hosting, domain registration (.co.ke, .com, .africa), business email (@yourdomain), SSL certificates, CDN, DDoS protection, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
3. **Market** — SEO / AEO / GEO (Google, AI search engines, Google Maps), Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, social media management, email marketing, and lead generation funnels.
4. **Automate with Zeepo AI** — AI-powered content creation, automated marketing campaigns, CRM workflows, chatbot flows, lead nurturing sequences, and AI email campaigns.

## Why Nisc Cloud

- One team that owns your brand, hosting, marketing, and automation
- One invoice instead of juggling multiple vendors
- 500+ businesses powered across Kenya and Africa
- 300+ campaigns delivered
- KES 50M+ in revenue generated for clients
- 99.9% uptime guaranteed
- 24/7 Kenya-based support
- Results in 30 days or we keep working
- M-Pesa, Visa, Mastercard, and bank transfer accepted
